$comment: Permissions schema for roles; please keep in sync with supabase/schemas/roles.sql and supabase/schemas/clubs.sql

canWriteFiles.description: Determines if the user can upload and modify files

canReadFiles.description: Determines if the user can view files

canWriteOwnReport.description: Determines if the user can create and edit their own reports

canReadAllReports.description: Determines if the user can view all reports

canWriteReportReview.description: Determines if the user can create and edit their own report reviews for others

canWriteCalendar.description: Determines if the user can create and edit calendar events

canReadCalendar.description: Determines if the user can view calendar events

canManageClub.description: Determines if the user can manage club settings and invite members
